table.text: Trajan's Market was established around 100 CE in Rome. It had many buildings with shops on four levels.

These traveling markets were held in the Middle Ages (400﹘1400 CE) in Europe. They were set up in different towns, often close to castles, and used entertainment such as jugglers, magicians, and dancing bears to attract people to trade.
